snippet.title: QBIX Game Library: AstroRyders
snippet.description:
AstroRyders is the first game available with QBIX.
It's a 1-6 Player risky mission where you shoot aliens and solve puzzles to save the world!

Discover more about QBIX here: https://inowize.com/qbix
